# nixpkgs attributes of the NixOS image's system profile (Containerfile.nixos), all from the pinned revision;
# the profile holds exactly these. Lines starting with # are comments.
# The build environment itself is nixpkgs' own for kdePackages.kwin (nix print-dev-env) and is not listed here.
# nixpkgs' own KWin, as the Fedora images carry Fedora's
kdePackages.kwin
# Xwayland: the X11 suites start it, and the fork's CMake requires the executable (env-nixos.sh)
xwayland
# Run time: the session bus tools and glxgears (X11Window starts it) on PATH, Mesa's drivers (llvmpipe),
# and fonts
dbus
mesa-demos
mesa
noto-fonts
